section_summary.extract_value: This procedures section describes a single study conducted in mainland China between June and December 2015, where participants completed a paper-and-pencil questionnaire on campus. The study included translations of the BAS-2 (Body Appreciation Scale-2) along with other measures, with participants recruited from campus locations and providing written informed consent.
